note: The six galleries behind the six doors of the Digital Ambedkar Heritage Museum. Exactly six doors; no seventh door exists in the layout. Door index maps to the door's position in the hub, left to right.

zones.name: Early Life & Education
zones.subtitle: Mhow · Satara · Bombay · New York · London
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Follow the academic timeline from 1897 to 1927.
zones.description: A chronological gallery through childhood, schooling and the years of study abroad. Exhibits are arranged along a rising ramp so that the visitor physically walks the timeline from 1891 to 1927.

zones.name: Social Reform
zones.subtitle: Mahad · Nashik · London · Poona
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Complete Match the Event and Sort the Timeline.
zones.description: The campaigns of 1920–1936: the press, the satyagrahas, the Round Table Conferences and the Poona Pact. Two non-violent educational mini-games sit in the centre of the hall.

zones.name: Law & Constitution
zones.subtitle: Constituent Assembly · 1946–1950
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Study the Preamble, the Fundamental Rights and Article 32.
zones.description: Built around a circular constitutional table under a rotunda. Every article panel carries its citation, and the knowledge quiz explains the reasoning behind each answer.

zones.name: Books, Manuscripts & Scholarship
zones.subtitle: Scholarship · 1916–1957
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Open three books in the document viewer and record them in your archive.
zones.description: A research room: shelving, document tables, a scanning station and a reading desk. The document viewer supports page turning, magnification and metadata panels. Empty catalogue slots show where an institution attaches the scans it holds the rights to.

zones.name: Memorials & Historical Places
zones.subtitle: Eight places of memory across India
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Select a memorial on the map and walk through its reconstruction.
zones.description: A dimly lit hall with a large interactive map of India on the floor and eight illuminated plinths. Selecting a location loads a stylised, clearly labelled reconstruction the visitor can walk through, with narration and information panels.

zones.name: Legacy & Digital Archive
zones.subtitle: Search · Ask · Complete
zones.objectiveOnEnter: Search the archive, ask the Archive Guide, then take the final challenge.
zones.description: The technologically advanced wing: a curved digital archive wall, the search engine over the whole collection, the AI Archive Guide terminal, the audio and video archive, the achievement wall and the entrance to the final knowledge challenge.
